summary: One tab inside violet-tabs; its text is the tab's label.

usage.text: Use it only as a direct child of violet-tabs. Give it an id when the page sets or reads activeid; violet-tabs sets its slot, role, aria-selected, aria-controls and tabindex.
A disabled tab cannot be activated by click or keyboard, and the arrow keys skip it.

a11y.text: The violet-tab element itself gets role tab, so its text is its name; give an icon-only tab an aria-label on violet-tab.
